title: introduce-cohorted-phasewalk-simulator-and-compact-flame-exporter
author: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: We need a compact, deterministic workload synthesizer that can produce cohort-aware phase transitions and a lightweight flame export format for quick kernel attribution during iterative perf work. This PR introduces 'PhaseWalk', a small footprint simulator that generates labeled latency corpora with configurable cohort mixtures and temporal phase boundaries, plus an 'Epochal Shadow Runner' that runs baseline+candidate in lockstep to capture divergence indicators. Additionally, it adds a compact flame exporter (binary-friendly, JSON-lite segments) that reduces flamegraph payloads for long runs. The goal is to provide reproducible microbenchmarks that exercise multi-phase cache/KV behaviors and produce a concise profiling artifact for offline aggregation. Changes: 1) new simulator library implementing cohorted phase transitions, tunable by sequence length distribution, burstiness, and cohort skew; 2) epochal shadow runner that drives two kernels with synchronized RNG seeds and checkpoints KV cache priming at epoch boundaries; 3) compact flame exporter that serializes stack samples into a minimal segment format and embeds quantile sampling metadata; 4) deterministic unit and integration tests and a benchmark CI job to exercise matrix variants; 5) documentation and quickstart for running local validation and interpreting compact flames. Testing and validation: added deterministic test vectors (seeded RNG), golden latency histograms for 3 cohort mixes, CI benchmark job that runs on a reduced sample set (ci/benchmark.yml). Performance observations: PhaseWalk reproduces expected p95 shifts when cohort skew is increased and shows amplification of coldstart tails under high burstiness. The shadow runner highlights kernel divergence within 5 epochs for a misaligned KV cache eviction policy, producing a compact flame that points at allocator/kernel boundary hotspots. Backwards compatibility: no runtime or public API changes for existing benchmark runners. Checklist: [x] simulator implementation [x] shadow runner [x] compact flame exporter [x] unit + integration tests [x] docs + quickstart [x] CI benchmark job [x] reviewer sign-off. Merge method: squash. Related: ENG-4721 (phase-aware benchmark baseline), ENG-4799 (compact flame format RFC).

Aisha Patel (author): Added concurrency cap via PHASEWALK_MAX_WORKERS env and updated tests to use it. Reran CI locally.

release_notes: Introduced PhaseWalk simulator and epochal shadow runner for cohort-aware latency synthesis; added a compact flame export format to reduce profiling payloads and speed up kernel attribution. Useful for perf triage and regression debugging.
notes_for_ops: ci/benchmark.yml is intentionally lightweight; full runs should be executed on the benchmark lab cluster. Compact flame export uses a binary-friendly segment layout and a version header — ingestion tools must handle v1 segment format.
